notes.title: April 18, 2023 - v1.0g
notes.content:
* Bouncing tire special move now pushes the enemy back and is always a launcher
* Increased bouncing tire special move launch distance
* Bouncing tire special move damage was reduced
* Increased bubble gum special move launch distance
* Flying pizza special move now pushes the enemy forward if it is in the air
* Fridge monolith special move damage was reduced
* Increased rainbow puke special move launch distance
* New aggressor system was introduced:
  - Normals' animations can be cancelled during recovery when both players are on the ground (allowing a dial-a-combo-like mechanic)
  - An internal aggression meter determines if the player being hit should be pushed or launched
  - The player filling the aggression meter can not move (while the other player is in hitstun)
* Low punch, low kick, high punch and high kick damages were reduced
* Most pushback properties were changed and reduced
* Changed low sweep push distance
* Increased hitstun duration slightly
* Bat attack special move now pushes the enemy forward
* Hat trick special move recovery frames were reduced
* Increased high kick hitbox
* Flying kick special move now can be used in the air

notes.title: April 12, 2023 - v1.0f
notes.content:
* Decreased jumping still kick damage
* Low sweep now is unblockable if enemy was blocking without crouching
* Low sweep now pushes the enemy back
* Increased horseshoe kick special move x-axis velocity and now it has screen wrap too

notes.title: April 11, 2023 - v1.0e
notes.content:
* Jumping still kick now allows juggles if enemy was jumping
* Increased the roundhouse kick hitbox

notes.title: April 10, 2023 - v1.0d
notes.content:
* Jump-in punch launch height was slightly increased
* Punches now allow longer juggles
